git.tracked_secret_files: Shown when Publish stops before uploading. {{files}} is up to five project file paths separated by commas, such as .env, deploy/server.pem, followed by (+N) when there are more. Keep the paths and the (+N) exactly as they are.

project.linked_in_app_data: Shown when a folder opened in place and Oleafly's own data folder end up one inside the other, usually after one of them was moved. {{folder}} is only the folder's name, never a full path. Either folder can be the one inside.
project.folder_read_only: Shown when Oleafly can't save, create, rename, move, copy, import or delete something in a folder opened in place because part of that folder is read-only. {{name}} is a path inside the project, such as figures/plot.png or project.json. It can be a file that doesn't exist yet (a new file, or where a move, copy or import was going), a read-only folder that was being moved, or, when a delete stops partway, the item Oleafly couldn't remove, such as figures/plot.png inside a read-only figures folder. "Its folder" is the folder that holds {{name}}. "The folder you opened" is the whole folder opened in place, not the subfolder. The second sentence points to Copy into library, which is on the read-only banner and in the folder's menu in the Library. The banner only shows when the whole folder is read-only, so don't mention it.

zotero.library_not_readable: Shown when a Zotero API key is valid but has no access to the user's personal library. "Allow library access" is the checkbox label on the key's page at zotero.org. Keep it in English, because zotero.org shows it in English.
zotero.user_mismatch: Shown when the Zotero user ID typed in Settings differs from the account the API key belongs to. {{keyUserId}} is the key's numeric user ID and {{userId}} is the number the user typed.
zotero.too_large: Shown when the Zotero library is bigger than one import allows. The RDF export is Zotero's File, Export Collection, Zotero RDF option.

collab.turned_off: Shown when something asks for live collaboration while its switch is off. "Live collaboration" is the switch label and "Experimentation" is the Settings section that holds it. Use the same words as those two labels.

provider_credit.failed: {{provider}} is an AI provider name such as OpenRouter or DeepSeek. Keep it unchanged.

mathpix.rejected: {{reason}} is Mathpix's own English error text
mathpix.http_error: {{status}} is a numeric HTTP status code such as 502
mathpix.pdf_too_large_ipc: Shown when the webview hands a PDF to Mathpix as a long list of numbers (a fallback on some Linux systems) and the file is over 16 MB; the usual limit is 256 MB

terminal.wsl_missing: WSL is Windows Subsystem for Linux. Keep the name WSL. Shown in the terminal when the person picked WSL as the shell.
terminal.wsl_no_distro: WSL is Windows Subsystem for Linux. Keep the name WSL. A Linux distribution is an installed Linux system such as Ubuntu.
terminal.git_bash_missing: Git Bash and Git for Windows are product names. Keep them verbatim.
terminal.pwsh_missing: PowerShell 7 is a product name. Keep it verbatim.
terminal.shell_path_missing: {{path}} is the file path of the shell program the person entered in Settings. Shown in the terminal.

shell_command.path_failed: Windows only. PATH is the environment variable name. Keep it verbatim. {{directory}} is a folder path.
shell_command.in_use: Windows only. {{path}} is the oleafly.exe file. oleafly is the command name.
